notes: READ OFF A GRAPH: K_n,fl in m/s of Fair chart (log-log, F_lv 0.01-2, K 0.01-0.2 m/s), read by pixel position from the chart image embedded in the PDF (page 36 of the file, slide 37; 667 x 376 pixels; frame x 62.5-630.5 for log10 F -2 to log10 2, y 9.5-320.5 for log10 K log10 0.2 to -2; about 239 pixels per decade, so one pixel is about 1 % in K). Each value is the mean of the curve centre over the pixel columns within 0.02 in log10 F of the node. Left of F = 0.025 the curve labels cover part of the curves; the values at 0.01 and 0.02 are read where the curves are clear (x 64-67 and 138-152, the label text above the top curve removed). Read 2026-10-30.
conditions: non foaming systems, sigma = 20 dyn/cm, hw < 0.15 H, Ah/Aa = 0.1, dh < 6 mm (slide 37)
